ValidationRule.description: Moving to Credit Review needs a risk rating, DSCR, a recommended decision, and an LTV when the product is secured.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Credit Review"), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Risk_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(Debt_Service_Coverage_Ratio__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Recommended_Decision__c)), AND(Loan_Product__r.Collateral_Required__c, ISBLANK(Loan_To_Value_Ratio__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before Credit Review, enter the Risk Rating, Debt Service Coverage Ratio, and Recommended Decision. Secured products also need collateral so Loan-to-Value can be calculated.
